notes: v644 - corrects a false alarm the v643 '? why' button was raising, and lets a pending order's exits be repaired without cancelling it. THE FALSE ALARM: the fill engine deliberately ignores the day you PLACED an order. This app reads the closing prices, so by the time you act that day is over - its low happened before your order existed, and filling on it would be hindsight. The '? why' button did not apply that rule, so if a share dipped below your limit earlier on the day you placed the order, it announced 'it SHOULD have filled' about a day the app was right to skip. It now reports the placement day separately, explains why it does not count, gives the lowest price since then, and names how many days are still waiting to be checked. NEW BUTTON: every pending buy order now has an exits button beside price and cancel. It sets or repairs the take-profit and stop-loss in place, with the same validation as the buy form - a target must be above your buy limit and a stop below it, or the order would be sold the instant it filled. If an order is currently in that broken state the button turns red so you can see it at a glance. Practice money only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
